title: Nadia's Busy Weekend
gist_ar: نادية بتحكي كل اللي عملته السبت والأحد.
text: Last weekend was very busy for Nadia. On Saturday morning she cleaned her room and helped her mother in the kitchen. They cooked rice and chicken together. In the afternoon she visited her grandmother. They talked for two hours and listened to old music. Nadia walked home at six o'clock. On Sunday she studied English for three hours, because she wanted a good mark. Then she called her friend Mona. They watched a film and enjoyed it a lot. Nadia finished her homework late at night. She was tired, but she was happy.

questions.q: What did Nadia do on Saturday morning?
questions.q_ar: نادية عملت إيه الصبح يوم السبت؟
options: She cleaned her room and helped her mother

questions.q: How long did she talk with her grandmother?
questions.q_ar: قعدت تتكلم مع جدتها قد إيه؟

questions.q: Why did she study English on Sunday?
options: Because she wanted a good mark
